title: Weighted BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution trains a GPU word-level toxicity classifier with auxiliary identity prediction heads. It lowercases and regex-tokenizes comments, truncates them to 220 tokens, builds a training-derived vocabulary using a minimum frequency of 5 and a 200,000-type cap, maps pruned or unseen words to an unknown token, and pads batches dynamically. The model uses 256-dimensional learned embeddings with spatial embedding dropout, two 256-unit bidirectional LSTM layers, masked max and mean pooling, two 512-unit ReLU dense layers with a residual connection, and logits for toxicity plus identity labels. Toxicity loss is weighted binary cross-entropy, up-weighting identity-mention, non-identity toxic, and identity non-toxic examples; unweighted auxiliary BCE is added. Training runs four epochs with shuffled length-bucketed batches, Adam, mixed-precision gradient scaling, gradient clipping at 1.0, and exponential learning-rate decay. Inference applies sigmoid to the toxicity logit in evaluation batches.
